profile_text.body:
Okta is a public company (NASDAQ: OKTA, CIK 0001660134) that describes itself as providing secure identity for employees, customers, and AI. Its two platforms, Okta and Auth0, are positioned around secure access, authentication, and automation, with the company framing identity as central to business security and growth. The platforms are presented as extensible and designed to support customer, workforce, and non-human identity use cases.

On the AI side, Okta tracks a product called Okta AI, categorized under Security and Identity AI. It covers identity AI, risk-based authentication, privileged access, and identity threat detection. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings beyond the basic company profile are recorded in the held facts at this time.
